import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 105;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int k;
    static long n;
    
    static class Matrix {
        int[][] a = new int[MAXN][MAXN];

        Matrix() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                    a[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void identity(int size) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= size; i++) {
                a[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        void print() {
            for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k + 1; j++) {
                    System.out.print(a[i][j] + (j == k + 1 ? "\n" : " "));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int id(int x, int step) {
        if (x <= k) {
            return ((x + step - 1) % k) + 1;
        } else {
            return x;
        }
    }

    static Matrix moveMat(Matrix base, int step) {
        int s = step % k;
        Matrix res = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= k + 1; j++) {
                res.a[id(i, s)][id(j, s)] = base.a[i][j];
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static Matrix matMul(Matrix a, Matrix b) {
        Matrix res = new Matrix();
        int size = k + 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= size; i++) {
            for (int k_idx = 1; k_idx <= size; k_idx++) {
                if (a.a[i][k_idx] != 0) {
                    for (int j = 1; j <= size; j++) {
                        res.a[i][j] = (int)((res.a[i][j] + 1L * a.a[i][k_idx] * b.a[k_idx][j]) % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextInt();

        Matrix[] A = new Matrix[MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            A[i] = new Matrix();
        }
        int[] ans = new int[MAXN];

        A[0].identity(k + 1);
        A[0].a[1][1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= k + 1; i++) {
            A[0].a[1][i] = 1;
        }

        // Convert n to a mutable long
        long tempN = n;
        int len = 0;
        java.util.ArrayList<Long> V = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        while (tempN > 0) {
            V.add(tempN % k);
            tempN /= k;
            len++;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
            A[i] = A[i - 1];
            A[i].identity(k + 1);
            long p = k;
            int power = 0;
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) != 0) {
                    A[i] = matMul(A[i], moveMat(A[i - 1], (power ^ 1) << power));
                }
                A[i - 1] = matMul(moveMat(A[i - 1], 1 << power), A[i - 1]);
                p >>= 1;
                power++;
            }
        }

        int step = 0;
        ans[k + 1] = 1;
        for (int T = V.size() - 1; T >= 0; T--) {
            int cur = V.get(T).intValue();
            if (cur != 0) {
                int[] tmp = new int[MAXN];
                for (int t = 0; t < cur; t++) {
                    for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
                        tmp[i] = ans[i];
                        ans[i] = 0;
                    }
                    Matrix B = moveMat(A[T], t + step);
                    for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
                        for (int j = 1; j <= k + 1; j++) {
                            ans[i] = (int)((ans[i] + 1L * tmp[j] * B.a[i][j]) % MOD);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            step += cur;
        }

        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
            res = (res + ans[i]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }
}
